articles.title: Quicksilver Run

[M1+M5] A F Up close: Cracked-tile mosaic of blue-grey irregular cells, 15-40 px, each with a fine perforated dot texture, edged by dark grout lines. Larger soft light and dark patches pass underneath so some areas of cells look lighter, some in shadow. From a distance: Reads as dark blue-grey slate or gunmetal mosaic with a faint light-dark blotch; the grout net stays visible as a crackle. Measured spec (average): metal 140, roughness 88, coat 164.
